title: ccd_asi: support at least four ZWO ASI cameras with ST-4 ports
description:
Reported in the CloudMakers forum in November 2026 on INDIGO 3.0-11 with a Raspberry Pi 5: https://bb.cloudmakers.eu/viewtopic.php?p=11240#p11240

The trace shows that the ASI120MM Mini and ASI715MC each attach as a camera and a guider. The server receives the USB arrival event for the ASI183MC, which had attached as both a camera and a guider earlier, but skips it when it is plugged in third. The ccd_asi driver has five logical device slots and requires two free slots to attach a camera with an ST-4 port.

Acceptance criterion: four ST-4-equipped ASI cameras can be attached simultaneously through ccd_asi, and INDIGO enumerates all four cameras and their four corresponding guider devices. Verify the four-camera case with a targeted check.
